overrideProperties.Name: AK 7.62x39 X Products X-47 50-round drum magazine (Tape)
overrideProperties.Description: The X-47 is a 50-round drum magazine for 7.62x39 AK family assault rifles. Manufactured by X Products. Can also be supplied with .366 TKM ammo for use with the corresponding caliber AK-compatible weapons. Tape Version. Change the tape color from the magazine menu in your stash.
